description: bench/*.py under CPython, the Pystachy JIT and AOT, as bench/run.sh times them (whole process; JIT includes compilation and startup; AOT excludes its build), 5 rounds per program, mode order rotated each round, every process pinned to one CPU; combined stdout+stderr of every run equals CPython's
note: json_records.py's default run is too short to time this way (26 ms under CPython); its samples are kept but docs/performance.md leaves it out
